item.tib: dbal gsas dpa' bo gcig sgrub
item.coloph: bon dar nub kyi dus su/ bla chen dran pa khod spungs dang / stang chen dmu tsha gyer med dang / blon ra sam (sangs) khod ral gyis/ 'phel zab smon lam dkar nag btab nas/ sham po gang (gangs) lha ri'i nang / brag sman rnams 'dra ba'i 'og sogs po 'khros pa 'dra ba'i 'og la sbas so/ las dang skal pa ldan pa gcig gis rnyed par shog rnyed nas kyang g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa bsrung bar gyur cig smar zhing u ya li lo/ phri phral spar ya thum dag par gtugs snyo//
